bio.name: Abhishek Kumar
bio.title: Full Stack Web Developer | Graphics Designer
bio.headline: Full Stack Developer | Co-Founder @BullBear.Ai | React, Firebase, Next.js
bio.summary: I'm a passionate full-stack web developer and designer currently pursuing B.Tech in Electrical Engineering at Haldia Institute of Technology. From crafting SaaS platforms to building AI-driven fintech products, I bring a mix of design, development, and leadership to everything I do.

education.description: Currently pursuing Bachelor's degree with focus on software development and emerging technologies.
Completed higher secondary education with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

experience.description: Leading product development for AI-powered trading systems. Building scalable backend infrastructure, integrating ML models, and crafting seamless SaaS UIs for financial clarity.
achievements: Integrated ML models for market predictions

experience.description: Led frontend development of a SaaS platform from scratch, improved SEO, and managed a team to enhance reach and engagement.
achievements: Built SaaS platform from ground up

experience.description: Collaborated on building the GDG HIT website, focusing on design, performance, and UX to boost student engagement.
Contributed to the campus media portal, delivering dynamic content pages and mobile-responsive layouts.
Worked on scalable education-tech projects. Collaborated with teams to prototype solutions and develop project-based learning tools.

projects.title: Campus Connect
projects.description: A real-time task collaboration platform for college communities with auth, roles, notifications, and a reputation system.
projects.problem: Lack of efficient collaboration and task tracking within colleges. Students struggled to coordinate group projects and track progress effectively.
projects.solution: Created a dynamic task board with real-time chat, email authentication, badge system, and comprehensive dashboards using Firebase for seamless collaboration.
projects.learnings: Mastered Firebase Auth and Realtime Database, learned advanced animation techniques with Framer Motion, and gained expertise in responsive design patterns.
projects.future: Planning to develop a mobile app version, implement AI-powered task routing, and integrate calendar synchronization for better project management.

projects.title: FinAI (Hackfest 2025 - IIT Dhanbad)
projects.description: An AI-based stock and portfolio analysis tool built in a 36hr hackathon. Trained a financial ML model and designed end-to-end stock insights dashboard.
projects.problem: Traders lack real-time, intelligent financial predictions and struggle with complex market analysis without proper tools.
projects.solution: Built comprehensive ML pipelines and an intuitive stock sentiment dashboard that provides actionable insights for smarter trading decisions.
projects.learnings: Learned to work under extreme time pressure, improved teamwork skills, and discovered the powerful synergy between ML and web technologies.
projects.future: Planning to integrate brokerage APIs, add advanced charting capabilities, and implement real-time sentiment heatmaps for market analysis.

projects.title: Dev Blog Platform
projects.description: A full-featured blog platform with authentication, user dashboards, dynamic post creation, and media support using Cloudinary.
projects.problem: Content creators needed a minimal, modern blogging solution with rich text editing, secure auth, and media uploads—without relying on bloated CMS tools.
projects.solution: Developed a fully functional blog platform using Next.js for the frontend and server-side rendering, Prisma for database ORM, Express.js REST APIs for data operations, Cloudinary for image uploads, and NextAuth for secure user authentication.
projects.learnings: Learned how to integrate a complete auth system using NextAuth with role-based access, implement image storage via Cloudinary, and structure a full-stack app with clean separation between backend (Express) and frontend (Next.js).
projects.future: Plan to add markdown support, scheduled publishing, AI-generated summaries, and a notification system for user interactions.

projects.title: SkillSync AI
projects.description: An AI-powered networking platform that connects users based on shared or complementary skillsets. Enables real-time chat and team formation.
projects.problem: Finding ideal teammates or collaborators with matching or complementary skills is difficult, especially in large communities or remote environments.
projects.solution: Developed an intelligent matching system using AI to analyze user skills, preferences, and availability. Integrated real-time chat and team creation to foster instant collaboration.
projects.learnings: Gained experience in building AI-driven user matching algorithms, working with real-time chat systems using Socket.io, and enhancing user engagement with tailored recommendations.
projects.future: Plans to add calendar sync for collaboration schedules, skill endorsement system, gamified user progress, and integration with GitHub and LinkedIn for automatic skill imports.

projects.title: GDG Recruitment Management Platform
projects.description: Comprehensive recruitment management system built for Google Developer Group on Campus to streamline team member selection and application tracking.
projects.problem: GDG on Campus faced challenges managing hundreds of applications, tracking candidate progress, and coordinating between recruiters during team member selection process.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack platform with applicant dashboard, recruiter panel, automated screening, interview scheduling, and real-time status tracking to digitize the entire recruitment workflow.
projects.learnings: Gained expertise in building scalable web applications, user authentication systems, database design for complex workflows, and creating intuitive admin interfaces.
projects.future: Planning to add AI-powered resume screening, video interview integration, analytics dashboard, and bulk communication features.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A modern e-commerce platform currently in development with core features like payment integration, inventory management, and admin dashboard already implemented.
projects.problem: Small businesses needed an affordable, feature-rich e-commerce solution.
projects.solution: Built a scalable and modular architecture with essential e-commerce features such as secure payment processing, product inventory tracking, and admin analytics dashboard.
projects.learnings: Learned payment gateway integration, database optimization, and complex state management during MVP development.
projects.future: Currently in active development. Upcoming features include multi-vendor support, AI-powered product recommendations, real-time analytics, and a mobile application for end-users.
